series.name: Splits — Inverter & Fixed-Speed (shared platform)
series.notes: Orient wall splits (Cooltron, Smartron, Ecotron, Ultron, Megatron, Gigatron, QG, AUX-sourced, Vibe/AK, fixed-speed) share one display-code platform. Official core = 16 codes from Orient's 2020 blog (recovered via Wayback): E0–E5, E8, Eb, F0–F4, F6, F8, F9. Extended set (E6/E7/E9/EA, F5/F7/FA/FC/Fd, P0–P9, L0–L3, EC, LE01) comes from PK technician/retailer sources — see per-code confidence. Major F-series conflicts with AYS Online are recorded in each code's notes (official wording wins where they disagree). AUX is an OEM partner: AUX-published tables rhyme with Orient on many E/F entries but are not Orient-badged (docs/sources/orient.md). Reset (all models): remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON. Orient says reset = erase board memory, not just on/off. Service UAN: 0800-ORIENT / 0800-11635. Floor-standing-only codes live in floor-standing.json (all split codes also apply there).

meaning.en: The indoor unit drew more current than allowed (overload or electrical fault) and protection tripped.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ne allowed se zyada current liya (overload ya electrical fault) aur protection trip ho gayi.

causes.en: Overloaded indoor circuit / faulty wiring
causes.ur: Indoor circuit overload / wiring kharab

causes.en: Indoor PCB or fan motor drawing excessive current
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ya fan motor zyada current le raha hai

causes.en: Compressor-related stress reflected on the indoor side (some models)
causes.ur: Kuch models par compressor ka load indoor side par reflect hota hai

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Power isolated: check indoor wiring terminals and the circuit breaker
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor wiring terminals aur circuit breaker check karein

solutions.en: If it trips again immediately: technician-level indoor PCB/motor diagnosis — do not keep restarting
solutions.ur: Foran dobara trip ho to technician indoor PCB/motor dekhe — baar baar restart na karein

source.title: Orient official blog (BlueEast 17 Jun 2020) — recovered via Internet Archive capture 2025-01-23

title.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The indoor room-air temperature sensor (T1) is open, shorted, drifted or its connector is loose.
meaning.ur: Room air ka temperature sensor (T1) open/short/drift ho gaya ya connector dhila hai.

causes.en: Faulty or drifted room temperature sensor
causes.ur: Room temperature sensor kharab ya drift

causes.en: Loose sensor plug / damaged wire at indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor plug dhila ya indoor PCB par wire damage

causes.en: Sensor exposed to direct sun or a heat source
causes.ur: Sensor seedhi dhoop ya heat source ke qareeb

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Check sensor seating and wiring at the indoor PCB (power isolated)
solutions.ur: Power band karke sensor aur wiring indoor PCB par check karein

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance and replace if out of spec (technician)
solutions.ur: Technician resistance nape aur ghalat ho to sensor badlein

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: Orient official blog (BlueEast 17 Jun 2020) — recovered via Internet Archive capture 2025-01-23

title.ur: Outdoor condenser temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The outdoor condenser coil temperature sensor (T3) or its wiring is faulty.
meaning.ur: Outdoor condenser coil ka sensor (T3) ya uski wire kharab hai.

causes.en: Faulty outdoor coil sensor
causes.ur: Outdoor coil sensor kharab

causes.en: Connector loose / wire damaged at outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par connector dhila ya wire damage

causes.en: Outdoor unit overheating / blocked airflow
causes.ur: Outdoor unit overheat / hawa ka rasta block

solutions.en: Power off; ensure 2+ feet clearance around outdoor unit and clean the coil
solutions.ur: Power off karke outdoor ke aage 2 feet jagah aur saaf coil check karein

solutions.en: Inspect sensor and connector at outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par sensor aur connector check karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if readings are wrong (technician)
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat ho to sensor badlein (technician)

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: Orient official blog (BlueEast 17 Jun 2020) — recovered via Internet Archive capture 2025-01-23

title.ur: Indoor evaporator/coil temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The indoor evaporator pipe temperature sensor (T2) is faulty or disconnected. Frequently seen on Orient DC inverters (video evidence).
meaning.ur: Evaporator pipe ka sensor (T2) kharab ya disconnect hai. Orient DC inverter par aksar aata hai (video evidence).

causes.en: Faulty pipe sensor or loose connection
causes.ur: Pipe sensor kharab ya connection dhila

causes.en: Sensor wire damaged (rats, service)
causes.ur: Sensor wire chuhe/service se damage

causes.en: Sensor fallen out of the coil pocket
causes.ur: Sensor coil pocket se bahar

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Inspect sensor placement in the coil and continuity to indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Coil mein sensor ki jagah aur indoor PCB tak continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if resistance is wrong (technician)
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat ho to sensor badlein (technician)

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: Orient official blog (BlueEast 17 Jun 2020) — recovered via Internet Archive capture 2025-01-23

title.ur: AC ya DC motor ki fault

meaning.en: The unit detected a problem with an AC or DC fan motor (indoor blower or outdoor fan depending on model).
meaning.ur: Unit ko kisi AC ya DC fan motor mein masla mila (model ke mutabiq indoor blower ya outdoor fan).

causes.en: Motor winding open/short or motor seized
causes.ur: Motor winding open/short ya motor jam

causes.en: Loose motor connector / damaged harness
causes.ur: Motor connector dhila ho ya harness kharab ho

causes.en: Fan capacitor weak (AC-motor models)
causes.ur: Fan capacitor kamzor (AC-motor models)

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Power isolated: check that the fan spins freely and connectors are tight
solutions.ur: Power band karke fan azaad ghoomta ho aur connectors kasi hon check karein

solutions.en: Technician tests motor voltages/continuity and capacitor; replace as needed
solutions.ur: Technician motor voltage/continuity aur capacitor check kare; zaroorat ho to badlein

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units have lost communication (signal wire, outdoor main PCB, or indoor PCB).
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units aapas mein baat karna band kar gaye (signal wire, outdoor main PCB ya indoor PCB).

causes.en: Loose, corroded or broken interconnect cable
causes.ur: Interconnect cable dhili, zang ya tooti

causes.en: Poor/ unstable supply disturbing the communication line
causes.ur: Voltage unstable hona communication line bigaar raha hai

causes.en: Outdoor main PCB or indoor PCB communication circuit fault
causes.ur: Outdoor main PCB ya indoor PCB ka communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle first: remote off → breaker off 5–10 min → breaker on → remote on
solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.en: Power isolated: re-check both terminal blocks — wires tight, clean, correct order
solutions.ur: Power band karke dono terminal blocks dobara check karein — wires saaf, kasi hui, sahi order mein

solutions.en: Use a stabilizer if the area has low/high voltage
solutions.ur: Ilaake mein voltage kharab ho to stabilizer lagwayein

solutions.en: If still present: technician checks outdoor/main PCB (common Orient E5 class)
solutions.ur: Phir bhi aaye to technician outdoor/main PCB check kare (Orient mein E5 ka common class)

title.ur: Split par compressor overload / cabinet par sliding door fault

meaning.en: On wall splits Electra Fix lists E6 as compressor overload protection. On vertical/cabinet Orient units mbsmpro lists E6 as a sliding-door (motorized door) fault. Meaning is unit-type dependent.
meaning.ur: Wall split par Electra Fix E6 ko compressor overload kehta hai. Vertical/cabinet Orient par mbsmpro E6 ko sliding door (motorized door) fault kehta hai. Matlab unit type par depend karta hai.

causes.en: Compressor overload: high pressure, dirty condenser, electrical issue (split reading)
causes.ur: Compressor overload: pressure zyada, ganda condenser, electrical masla (split wala matlab)

causes.en: Sliding-door latch/sensor not closed (cabinet reading)
causes.ur: Sliding door latch/sensor band nahi (cabinet wala matlab)

solutions.en: Stop the unit and let the compressor cool; wash outdoor coil
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur compressor ko thanda hone dein; outdoor coil dhoyein

solutions.en: On cabinet units: check door fully closed and door sensor switch
solutions.ur: Cabinet units par door mukammal band ho aur door sensor switch check karein

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: Electra Fix — Orient Inverter AC Error Code List

solutions.ur: Technician fan motor aur capacitor test kare

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

title.en: Display Board ↔ Main PCB Communication Fault
title.ur: Display board aur main PCB mein communication fault

meaning.en: The indoor display board is not talking to the main indoor PCB (ribbon cable, connector, or board failure). Corroborated by PK service content (bulao.pk).
meaning.ur: Indoor display board aur main PCB aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (ribbon cable, connector ya board). PK service content (bulao.pk) se bhi support mila hai.

causes.en: Ribbon cable unseated between display and PCB
causes.ur: Display aur PCB ke darmiyan ribbon cable dhili

causes.en: Faulty display board or main indoor PCB
causes.ur: Display board ya main indoor PCB kharab

causes.en: Corroded connector pins
causes.ur: Connector pins par zang/kharabi

solutions.en: Power off; reseat the display ribbon cable carefully
solutions.ur: Power off karke display ribbon cable ko savadhan se dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Inspect connector pins for loose contact
solutions.ur: Connector pins loose contact ke liye dekhein

solutions.en: If code returns: technician tests/replaces display board or PCB
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician display board ya PCB test/badalay

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

meaning.en: The humidity sensor on advanced Orient models with humidity-control features has failed.

causes.ur: Indoor PCB tak wiring/connector masla

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor controller cannot detect the AC zero-crossing points needed to synchronize the fan motor.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor controller AC ke zero-crossing points detect nahi kar pata jo fan motor ko synchronize karne ke liye zaroori hain.

causes.en: Zero-crossing detection circuit / module faulty on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par zero-crossing detection circuit/module kharab

causes.ur: Mains waveform bigad hua (rare)

solutions.ur: Pehle reset karein: remote off → breaker 5–10 minute off → breaker on → remote on

solutions.ur: Technician: zero-crossing module badlein ya indoor PCB service/replace karein

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

title.ur: Outdoor PFC (power factor correction) ki protection

meaning.en: The PFC stage of the outdoor board reported a fault — usually unstable mains or PFC circuit failure.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka PFC stage fault batata hai — aam tor par kharab mains ya PFC circuit kharab.

causes.en: Unstable / low / high mains voltage
causes.ur: Mains voltage unstable, kam ya zyada

causes.en: PFC capacitor/reactor or board fault
causes.ur: PFC capacitor/reactor ya board kharab

causes.en: Loose supply wiring
causes.ur: Supply wiring dhili

solutions.en: Check input voltage with a meter; stabilizer in bad areas
solutions.ur: Meter se input voltage check karein; kharab area mein stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: Power cycle after voltage is stable
solutions.ur: Voltage theek hone par reset karein

solutions.en: If repeats on stable supply: technician board service
solutions.ur: Theek voltage par baar baar aaye to technician board service kare

title.en: Compressor Start Failure or Out-of-Step Error
title.ur: Compressor start nahi ho pa raha ya out-of-step

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start within the expected time or lost rotor synchronism (out-of-step).
meaning.ur: Compressor mutawaqqa time par start nahi hua ya rotor ka synchronization toot gaya (out-of-step).

causes.en: Weak/damaged start relay or capacitor
causes.ur: Start relay ya capacitor kamzor/kharab

causes.en: Compressor windings open/short or compressor stuck
causes.ur: Compressor winding open/short ya compressor jam

causes.en: Low voltage at start / out-of-step drive fault
causes.ur: Start par voltage kam / out-of-step drive fault

solutions.en: Check supply voltage under load (technician)
solutions.ur: Technician load par voltage check kare

solutions.en: Technician tests relay/capacitor and compressor continuity to earth
solutions.ur: Technician relay/capacitor aur compressor continuity to earth check kare

solutions.en: Compressor replacement if windings are bad
solutions.ur: Winding kharab ho to compressor badalna parega

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)

causes.ur: Gas leak — flare joints, coil ya valves par

causes.ur: Bahar temperature zyada / unit par seedhi dhoop

causes.ur: Kam gas / ganda condenser / block airflow

causes.ur: Ganda coil, kam gas ya zyada ambient se overheat
